title: Reducer production model: bridge legs, automated authorization provider, void path, revision pin
goal: Turn the fixture-only cycle reducer into a production-capable state machine without breaking the fixture tests: model the two bridge legs explicitly, replace the per-step fixture owner signatures with a pluggable authorization provider (fixture mode for tests, standing-authority policy signer for production), add a void/terminal path for external mutations that never broadcast, replace exact-zero isolation invariants on publicly fundable accounts with exact-delta accounting, fix the buyback NFT/Circle USD unit conflation, and unpin the preflight from revision 56 (closes confirmed findings HK-019, HK-020, HK-023, HK-024, HK-025, HK-026, HK-027, HK-028, HK-030).
readSet: codex/complete-v4-hook reducer.mjs delta (supersedeUnobservedIntent) as technique reference
steps: Introduce an AuthorizationProvider interface (verifyStepAuthorization(intent) -> verified record) with two implementations: FixtureAuthorizationProvider (current Ed25519 fixture keys, used by every existing test) and StandingAuthorityProvider (verifies a policy-signed step authorization bound to an owner-signed standing-authority document with per-cycle spend cap, cycles-per-day cap, allowed packs, allowed destinations, expiry; keys are injected, never read from files); the reducer must not know which one is active

Model the outbound leg (Robinhood USDG -> Solana Circle USD via Relay) and the return leg (Solana Circle USD -> Robinhood USDG) as explicit reducer stages with their own intents, request digests, chain identifiers (eip155:4663 and solana mainnet genesis), and receipt kinds; stop forcing every action onto Solana and stop comparing block heights across chains

Add a void path: an external-mutation-attempted record may be resolved as VOID when a signed observer proof shows the signed bytes were never broadcast before their last-valid height (or nonce/expiry), allowing a fresh intent with a new digest; keep supersedeUnobservedIntent semantics compatible with WP-07's port
Replace exact-zero balance invariants on publicly fundable accounts with exact expected-delta accounting (before/after, attributable amounts), so a stray donation cannot wedge the cycle
Fix the buyback accounting so the NFT unit (quantity 1) and the Circle USD refund amount are separate fields with separate checks
Enforce the vault-debit ordering: no purchase intent before the funding stage is finalized and the Collector generate response is verified

Make preflight accept the current interfaces.json product phase and revision (read them from architecture/interfaces.json, do not hardcode 56) while still failing closed on a missing or malformed freeze

Keep decoder.mjs's fixture envelope for tests and add a DecodedMessage schema that WP-10's real Solana/EVM decoders (in packages/adapters) can produce; the reducer validates the decoded schema, never raw bytes

Keep every existing fixture test green (adapt fixtures where the schema changes; do not delete tests) and add tests for the standing-authority provider (cap exceeded, wrong pack, expired document, wrong destination all reject), the void path, the two bridge legs, and the buyback unit split
Update docs/modules/cycle-runner.md and its index digest
acceptance: All existing runner tests pass (adapted, not deleted) and new provider/void/bridge-leg tests pass
No fixture Ed25519 key is required by the production authorization provider path
A never-broadcast mutation can be voided with observer proof and the cycle continues with a fresh intent
Preflight passes against the merged tree's interfaces.json without a hardcoded revision
packages/runner still imports only Node builtins
notes: Highest-leverage runner change; fresh-context independent review required. Coordinate schema names with WP-07 (cycle-runner.mjs) which runs in the next group and will adapt to your exported API; document every exported function change in notes.
